newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - TT Tieto 9-mth profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - TT Tieto 9-mth profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 124 million markka median forecast for data service group TT Tieto Oy's January-September profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
*EPS forecasts by six analysts of nine in survey
TT Tieto's nine-month results are due on November 6 at 0900/0700 GMT.
In January-September 1995, TT Tieto posted a 65.4 million markka profit before extraordinary items.

The analysts polled by Reuters forecast for TT Tieto a full-year 1996 median profit of 171 million markka (range 165-185 million markka) and a median EPS of 13 markka (range 12-15 FIM). The group's 1995 profit was 96 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Merita, Opstock and Postipankki.
